999008199.text:
はぁ、はぁっ……油断した……
まさか親個体があれほどの強さとは……

localizations.en: Hah... hah... I let my guard down... I never imagined the parent monster would be that powerful...

999008199.text:
ん？　おや……ちょっとお前さん、どうしたんだい！？
足と腕、折れてるじゃないか

localizations.en: Hm? Oh my... hey there, what happened to you?! Your arm and leg are broken!

999008199.text: えっ……隠しているのに、見ただけで……？

localizations.en: What...? I was hiding it, but you could tell just by looking...?

999008199.text:
ほら、こっちにおいでなさんな。
ちょうどいい薬草が残ってたはずだよ

localizations.en: Here, come over this way. I should have some good medicinal herbs that might do the trick.

999008199.text:
ほい、これで大丈夫。
二、三日もすればとりあえず動けるよ

localizations.en: There, that should do it. Give it two or three days and you'll at least be able to move around.

999008199.text: あ、ありがとうございます……

礼を言われるようなこたぁしちゃいないよ。
人として当然のことをしたまでさ

localizations.en: Don't thank me for something like this. I just did what any decent person would do.

999008199.text:
しかしお前さんも無茶するね。
魔物退治でこんなとこまでくるなんて

localizations.en: Though you really are reckless, coming all the way out here to hunt monsters.

999008199.text: 「管理」は、役目なので……

役目ねぇ……ま、よく分からんけど！
いいかい、三日は安静にしとくんだよ

localizations.en: Duty, huh... Well, I don't really get it, but listen! You're staying put for three days.

999008199.text: その間に、アタシが片を付けといてやるよ

localizations.en: I'll take care of this mess while you recover.

999008199.text: ギャオオォッ……！

ふう、これでよし。魔物の母親も倒したし、
村が襲われる心配もなくなったさね

localizations.en: Phew, that's that. Took down the monster's mother too, so the village won't have to worry about attacks anymore.

999008199.text: に、人間が……「管理」対象の魔物を……？

localizations.en: A-a human... defeated a monster slated for management...?

999008199.text:
家族を守ろうとしたこいつは必死だよ。
でもね、それはアタシも同じだからね

localizations.en: This thing was just desperate to protect its family. But guess what? So am I.

999008199.text:
村っていう家族を守るため……
ま、お前さんは居候ってところだけど

localizations.en: Protecting my family—the village, that is... Well, you're more like a houseguest at this point.

999008199.text:
私も……家族？
そんなこと、言われるなんて……

localizations.en: Me... family too? I never thought anyone would say something like that to me...

999008199.text:
そう、居候。足が治りゃ、お客様期間も終わりだよ。
薬草を摘んでくる！　働かざる者食うべからず！

localizations.en: Yep, a houseguest. Once that leg heals up, your guest privileges are over. You'll be gathering medicinal herbs! No work, no food!

999008199.text: は、はいっ！！

……村長さん、ありがとうございました。
おかげで、すっかり元気になりました

localizations.en: ...Chief, thank you so much. Thanks to you, I'm completely recovered.

999008199.text: もう行っちまうのかい。寂しくなるねぇ……

localizations.en: You're leaving already? It's gonna be lonely around here...

999008199.text:
ほんの、短い期間でしたけど……
村長さんには、大切なことを教えていただきました

localizations.en: It was only a short time, but during my stay, you taught me something very important.

999008199.text:
損得抜きで弱き者を助け、己を貫く生きざま……
このような人間もいるのだ、と……

localizations.en: That one should help the weak without expecting anything in return, and live true to yourself... plus I learned that there are humans like you in this world...

999008199.text: なーにおべっか使ってんだい、ケツが痒くなるよ

localizations.en: What're you buttering me up for? Don't make it sound so cringey.

999008199.text: その、たまに言葉遣いが乱暴ですけど……

localizations.en: You have a... way with words sometimes...

999008199.text:
はっはっは、これぐらいじゃなきゃ
大家族を養っていけないもんでね！

localizations.en: Hahaha! You gotta be tough when you're feeding a big family!

999008199.text:
……私、今まで自分の仕事に疑問を持ったことは
一度もありませんでした

localizations.en: ...I've never once questioned my work before now.

999008199.text:
でも、自分に正直に……まっすぐ生きている
あなたを見て、ちょっと、悩みました

localizations.en: But seeing you live so honestly and true to yourself made me question it... even if just a little.

999008199.text:
これって、私が本当にしたいことなのかな、って……
私は、できるなら村長さんみたいに……

localizations.en: Is this really what I want to be doing? If I could choose, I'd want to be like you...

999008199.text:
……お前さんは不思議な子だね。
なんで魔物を退治して回ってんのか知らないけど

localizations.en: ...You're a strange kid. I don't know why you go around hunting monsters.

999008199.text:
人生って道は長いんだ。疲れたときは立ち止まって、
またこの村においでよ。お前さんも家族の一人だ

localizations.en: But life's a long road. When you get tired, take a break and come back to visit. You're family here too.

999008199.text:
はい……！
村長さん、ありがとうございます！

あ、あの……！
最後にお名前だけ、教えていただいても……

localizations.en: Oh, um...! Could you tell me your name, at least...?

999008199.text:
ん？　そういえばみんな村長とかおっかあとか
適当に呼ぶから知らなかったかい

localizations.en: Hm? Come to think of it, everyone just calls me Chief or Ma, so you probably never heard it.

999008199.text: アタシはね、イェルカってんだ
